dz: 圣维森特战役(Battle of São Vicente)发生在葡萄牙巴西近海,由航海家爱德华·芬顿率领的三艘英国战舰在此过程中击落了三艘西班牙加仑一号沉没.
de: Battle of São Vicente takes place off Portuguese Brazil where three English warships led by navigator Edward Fenton fight off three Spanish galleons sinking one in the process.
